address: Shop 309, 3F, Adjoining Building, Kingold Century, 62 Jinsui Road, Tianhe, Guangzhou, China Mainland
bio: Commanding spectacular city views, the sun-drenched, plant-filled space caters to a well-heeled business clientele. The Western-centric menu focuses on vegetables and mushrooms, as opposed to typical Chinese vegetarian cuisine based on soy faux meats. The bamboo fungus with pickled radish, chilli and rattan pepper has a wonderfully crisp texture and tingling tanginess. The deep-fried Yunnan eggplant with vegan demi-glace is also unmissable....
